# summary
We ask the {p:forums.design_authority.short} to approve the booking service design so build can start in November.

## scope
The design covers online booking, the carrier gateway and the finance feed for release one. Depot printing is in scope; returns are not.

## decision-sought
We seek two decisions before build starts.

REGISTER decision-request

## overview
The service runs on {dep:SHB} and adds no new platform. It carries {count:risk where rating=high|extreme} high or extreme risks, and the carrier contract is still open.
